purpose: The freeze-v2 receipt pins the exact source that authorized it. Freeze v2 could not execute any scientific job, so freeze v3 had to make the protocol select its freeze builder from the receipt's own freezeId instead of hard-coding v2. That edit changes a file the v2 receipt binds, so v2 can no longer be rebuilt from the working tree. Every divergence is declared here with the frozen hash and a location the frozen bytes are still recoverable from, so the v2 provenance chain and its FAIL CLOSED record stay complete and auditable.

divergences.reason: Adds FREEZE_MODULES and freeze_module_for so read_freeze selects the builder that owns a receipt. Freeze v2 hard-coded wp14r_freeze_v2.py, which made a v3 receipt unverifiable by the protocol. Selection is safe because the selected builder rebuilds the whole receipt from source and compares it.
